# Carrot soup

Type: Food | Internal ID: CarrotSoup | Source: Cauldron | Usage: Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Mushroom x1, Carrot x3 | Max Health: 15 | Max Stamina: 45 | Duration: 25m | Healing: 2 hp/tick

# Introduction

Carrot soup is a Black Forest-tier food.

## Recipe

Carrot soup is produced in a level 1 Cauldron with:
• 3 Carrot
• 1 Mushroom

## Notes

Carrot soup provides the highest stamina gain in the Black Forest at 45.
